title: Working at Coinbase: Legal Team
description:
Looking to #LiveCrypto and lead the future of commercial legal? Coinbase’s Head of Commercial Legal Molly Abraham details what she looks for in a candidate.


We’re hiring, look for open positions at: https://grnh.se/dee212541us 

#LiveCrypto #Coinbase #WorkingInTech

asr.full_text: I'm Mollie Abraham and I lead the commercial legal team at Coinbase. Every single day is something totally new and different and I feel like I'm working on issues that are creating an entire new industry yet to come. My favorite part about being on the legal team has to be my colleagues. That's why I joined Coinbase. Everyone here is incredibly smart, collaborative, and we get to work on the hardest problems together, so no two days are the same and every day is exciting. The top things I look for in candidates are someone who wants to be a continuous learner. At the end of the day, we're problem solvers. We're trying to help the business, ship great products, and do great deals in order to bring crypto to the masses. Whatever you've done before, in your legal career, it's going to be different here. There's no replicating past work because this is a totally new industry Candidates should apply for roles on the legal team if they're looking to do the most cutting-edge work of their career and literally set precedent for the next evolution of the internet
